title: On Saying nothing about the money
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：say　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 say 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the planner ① said nothing about the money on the same day, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the planner ② says nothing about the money before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ say nothing about the money at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ said nothing about the money before — a line in the report for March 1965 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Saying nothing about the money on the same day, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the plan at the far square, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ say no more than the date before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Say no more than the date at once and never mention it again.

By 1978 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the report, and a new citizen from the next district ⑧ says no more than the date on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the square, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ said nothing about the money again when nobody else would.

⑩ To say nothing about the money, my mother said in 1983, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the district remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the district forgets, somebody says nothing about the money before dawn again and somebody must say nothing about the money on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 说（一般过去式 said nothing about the money：1971 年规划员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 说（一般现在 says nothing about the money：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 说（不定式 to say nothing about the money：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 说（过去完成时 had said nothing about the money：1965 年三月的规划报告上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 说（动名词 saying nothing about the money 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 写着（say no more than the date：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去写着在纸上只写了个日期）
G. v. 写着（say no more than the date：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 说（后段两处：新来的市民照例 says no more than the date，而母亲又一次 said nothing about the money）

answers.why: say 意为“说”，1971 年规划员当天就说对钱的事一个字也没提，那是街区里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 said。
say 意为“说”，自那以后规划员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 says。
say 意为“说”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯说对钱的事一个字也没提”，此处为不定式 to say nothing about the money。
say 意为“说”，规划报告里 三月 那行字说明早在 1978 年之前就有人说过，故用过去完成时 had said。
say 意为“说”，规划员说“说对钱的事一个字也没提这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 saying nothing about the money 作主语。
say 意为“写着”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去写着在纸上只写了个日期”，should ever 之后用原形 say no more than the date。
say 意为“写着”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻写着在纸上只写了个日期（say no more than the date at once），以后再也不要提起。
say 意为“说”，新来的市民每个年份都照例写着在纸上只写了个日期，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 says。
say 意为“说”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就说对钱的事一个字也没提，用一般过去式 said 叙述。
say 意为“说”，结尾那句是母亲 1983 年的话：要说对钱的事一个字也没提，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和街区记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，规划员当天就说对钱的事一个字也没提；街区里每一个市民都说这是头一回。（said nothing about the money）
多年以后，规划员仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（says nothing about the money）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯说对钱的事一个字也没提这件事本身。（to say nothing about the money）
早在 1965 年就有人说对钱的事一个字也没提，三月那天规划报告上的一行字就是证据。（had said nothing about the money）
规划员说过，当天就说对钱的事一个字也没提这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（saying nothing about the money 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻写着在纸上只写了个日期，以后再也不要提起。（say no more than the date，祈使句）
answers: In 1971 the planner said nothing about the money on the same day, and every citizen in the district said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three years on, the planner still says nothing about the money before dawn without being asked.
My mother said later that to say nothing about the money at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had said nothing about the money long before 1978, and the line in the report for March proves it.
Saying nothing about the money on the same day, the planner said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 say 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the planner said nothing about the money on the same day, and nobody in the district forgot it.
Even now the planner says nothing about the money before dawn whenever the district asks.
Saying nothing about the money on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever say no more than the date before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new citizen from the next district says no more than the date on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother said nothing about the money again, and the district remembered that half.
